treaty_name: Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Cyprus and the Government of the Republic of Armenia for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2011, as modified by the MLI)
eif_quote: [CY list] 6 Αρμενία 17/01/2011 19/09/2011 4145 – 05 /09/ 2011 || [AM MLI position] ...s on Income Republic of Cyprus Original 17-01-2011 19-09-2011
source_title: Synthesised text of the MLI and the CY-AM Agreement (MLI_SynthesizedTextCyprus.docx, Armenian MoF)

rates.quote: 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner has invested in the capital of the company not less than the equivalent of 150.000 Euro at the time of the investment;
5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the royalties, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit

notes: Dividend 0% tier conditioned on an investment of at least EUR 150,000 in the capital of the paying company at the time of investment (no percentage threshold; ownership_threshold null). Art. 11(3): interest taxable only in residence State if paid to the State, subdivision, local authority, statutory body or Central Bank, or on loans granted or guaranteed by them. MLI Art. 8 not applied (no box). Art. 27: WHT on income derived on or after 1 January of the year following EIF (2011-09-19 -> 2012-01-01). Synthesised text: MLI effective for WHT where the event occurs on or after 1 January 2024.
